ad-valorem-duty.name: Ad Valorem Duty Calculator
ad-valorem-duty.intro: Compute ad valorem duty from the dutiable value and the ad valorem rate: T = value × rate.

average-tax-rate.name: Average Tax Rate Calculator
average-tax-rate.intro: Find the average tax rate from total tax paid and total income: ATR = T / Y.

break-even-taxable.name: Break-Even Taxable Income Calculator
break-even-taxable.intro: Work out the taxable income at which the tax liability offsets a fixed deduction, given the marginal rate.

capital-gains-effective.name: Effective Capital Gains Tax Calculator
capital-gains-effective.intro: Compute tax on capital gains using a preferential rate: T = gain × preferential rate.

capital-gains-tax.name: Capital Gains Tax Calculator
capital-gains-tax.intro: Estimate capital gains tax on an asset sale from proceeds, cost basis and the applicable rate.

corporate-income-tax.name: Corporate Income Tax Calculator
corporate-income-tax.intro: Compute corporate income tax: T = taxable income × corporate rate.

customs-duty.name: Import Customs Duty Calculator
customs-duty.intro: Calculate import duty from the customs value and the duty rate.

effective-tax-rate.name: Effective Tax Rate Calculator
effective-tax-rate.intro: Find the effective tax rate: total tax ÷ pre-tax income.

excise-tax.name: Excise Tax Calculator
excise-tax.intro: Compute excise tax from factory price, quantity and the excise rate: T = price × qty × rate.

foreign-tax-credit.name: Foreign Tax Credit Calculator
foreign-tax-credit.intro: Work out the creditable amount: min(foreign tax paid, credit limit).

gift-tax.name: Gift Tax Calculator
gift-tax.intro: Compute gift tax: T = max(gift − exemption, 0) × rate.

gst-calculator.name: GST Calculator
gst-calculator.intro: Convert between GST-inclusive and GST-exclusive amounts at any GST rate to separate the tax from the base price.

interest-income-tax.name: Interest Income Tax Calculator
interest-income-tax.intro: Compute tax on interest income: T = interest × rate.

marginal-tax-rate.name: Marginal Tax Rate Calculator
marginal-tax-rate.intro: Find the marginal tax rate from the change in tax and the change in income: MTR = (T₂ − T₁) / (Y₂ − Y₁).

payroll-tax.name: Payroll Tax Calculator
payroll-tax.intro: Compute total payroll tax: T = wages × (employer rate + employee rate).

progressive-income-tax.name: Progressive Income Tax Calculator
progressive-income-tax.intro: Compute progressive income tax by summing each bracket: (income − lower bound) × bracket rate.

property-tax.name: Property Tax Calculator
property-tax.intro: Compute property tax: T = assessed value × rate.

reverse-charge.name: Reverse Charge VAT Calculator
reverse-charge.intro: Compute the reverse-charge tax amount: T = amount × charge rate.

sales-tax-addon.name: Sales Tax (Tax-Exclusive) Calculator
sales-tax-addon.intro: Add sales tax to a tax-exclusive price: gross = price × (1 + rate).

social-security-tax.name: Social Security Contribution Calculator
social-security-tax.intro: Compute social security contributions: T = contribution base × rate.

specific-duty.name: Specific Duty Calculator
specific-duty.intro: Compute specific duty: T = quantity × unit duty amount.

stamp-duty.name: Stamp Duty Calculator
stamp-duty.intro: Compute stamp duty: T = instrument amount × stamp duty rate.

tax-credit.name: Tax Credit Calculator
tax-credit.intro: Compute tax payable after credits: T' = tax liability − credit.

tax-on-discount.name: Tax on Discounted Price Calculator
tax-on-discount.intro: Calculate the tax applied to a discounted price after the markdown is taken.

tax-to-gdp.name: Tax-to-GDP Ratio Calculator
tax-to-gdp.intro: Compute the tax-to-GDP ratio: total tax ÷ GDP.

vat-from-exclusive.name: VAT from Tax-Exclusive Price Calculator
vat-from-exclusive.intro: Compute VAT from a tax-exclusive amount: T = amount × rate.

vat-inclusive-to-exclusive.name: VAT-Inclusive to Exclusive Calculator
vat-inclusive-to-exclusive.intro: Strip VAT from a tax-inclusive price: net = gross ÷ (1 + rate).

vat-output.name: Output VAT Calculator
vat-output.intro: Compute output VAT: T = sales × VAT rate.

withholding-tax.name: Withholding Tax Calculator
withholding-tax.intro: Compute withholding tax: T = payment × withholding rate.
